name: Kanshin
source:
「Please notice me a little bit more… honestly… But it’s true that I’m strong though…」

The strongest general in [url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuuhou[/url]'s army. She is a military genius known as "Kokushi Musou."
 
Despite being a modest private, she is isolated from the rest of [url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuuhou[/url]'s army due to her constant boastings. 

[url=https://vndb.org/c136825]Ryuuhou[/url]'s army scouted her after a major push by [url=https://vndb.org/c136830]Shibasen[/url] and was unexpectedly appointed commander-in-chief.

Because she had never been praised for her abilities, even the slightest acknowledgment would make her soar to the skies. 

A rollercoaster of feeling and approval.
